title: Base-two ceiling logarithm of two
statement: The base-two ceiling logarithm of $2$ equals $1$: $\lceil\log_2 2\rceil=1$.
replaced:
The base-$2$ ceiling logarithm of $2$ equals $1$: $\lceil \log_2 2 \rceil = 1$,
i.e.\ \texttt{Nat.clog 2 2 = 1}. This is a small arithmetic fact used in the
deterministic upper bound for the equality function.
